title: Excellent product successfully delivered by UPS
text:
Excellent product successfully delivered by UPS. This is an excellent product that I have purchased several times.

The Seller, Handy-Bargains, did an extraordinarily excellent job of overcoming repeated and peculiar problems caused by their selected Delivery Service's decision to report FALSE delivery information to the Seller.
This false information led to much confusion between the Seller and Buyer. Finally, the Seller's decided to use a much more respected and trustworthy Delivery Service for their fourth attempted shipment.
That fourth shipment was successfully delivered. 🙂

product_metadata.title: Sterilite 19414306 7.5 Quart Clear Plastic Storage Container Box and Lid with Blue Latches (12 Pack)
features: 7.5 QUARTS: Includes 12 storage bins and lids; Ideal storage solution for keepsakes, photographs, important documents, linens, clothing, and other items that need to be stored away and protected
SAFEGUARD SEAL: Offers a gasket seal to safeguard items from both air and moisture, keeping those special belongings safe from the elements, dust and pests
DURABLE: Durable, tight-fitting latches keep the lid secured to the base, and the clear lid and base allow contents to be easily identified, without opening the lid
EASY TO TRANSPORT: Features 2 rear wheels for easy and convenient transportation
DIMENSIONS: Storage box has a length of 20 inches, width of 9 inches, and height of 13 inches
description: Need help getting organized? The Sterilite 7.5-Quart Clear Storage Container will help you with your moving or storage needs. This package includes 12 storage bins and lids. These durable storage totes feature a 7.5-quart capacity and are an ideal solution for keepsakes, photographs, important documents, linens, clothing, and other items that need to be stored away and protected. The latching lid attaches to the base to ensure your belongings stay safe and secure during a move or while in storage. The gasket seals both air and moisture, keeping those special belongings safe from the elements, dust, and pests. Durable, tight-fitting latches keep the lid secured to the base, and the clear lid and base allow contents to be easily identified, without opening the lid. Quality is key when it comes to choosing storage materials. That's why the Sterilite 7.5-Quart Clear Storage Container is crafted from durable plastic to keep your possessions protected.
